summary: Frontend-only testing of the NEW Gold Loan Calculator at /calculators/gold-loan-calculator (Tests A–H, Smart Insight, regression, accessibility). All 8 primary test cases (A–H) plus Smart Insight, currency switching (USD→EUR→INR), localStorage persistence across reload, validation error messages (LTV/rate/weight/deduction overflow), NaN/Infinity absence, and mobile 390px non-overflow all PASS. Regression on Percentage and Loan calculators still works. Finance category page correctly lists Gold Loan Calculator alongside Loan Calculator (2 CALCULATORS). One minor discoverability nit: Gold Loan Calculator is NOT shown in the homepage 'Popular Calculators' curated list (only the original 6 are listed) — the review request expected it to appear on the homepage. Not a functional bug since homepage shows only 'popular' items and the Finance category count updated to 2, but flagging as low-priority since the request explicitly asked for homepage listing.

issues: Gold Loan Calculator is not listed in the 'Popular Calculators' section on the homepage. Only the original 6 (Percentage, Age, BMI, Discount, Loan, Date) are shown. Review request asked for homepage to list Gold Loan Calculator. Finance category card correctly reflects '2 CALCULATORS'. Low priority — may be intentional (popular vs all).

test_results_detail.Homepage listing: MINOR — Gold Loan not in Popular Calculators section (see design_issues)

accessibility: PASS — All inputs (weight, purity, deduction mode, deduction value, rate, LTV, currency) have associated <label htmlFor=...>. Error messages use role='alert'. Smart Insight uses role='note' + aria-live='polite'.
action_items: Optional: consider adding Gold Loan Calculator to the homepage 'Popular Calculators' section (or clarify that only the original 6 are curated as 'popular'). Low priority — functionality is correct.
critical_code_review_comments: gold-loan-calculator.tsx is clean and well-structured (~240 lines). Validation ordering is correct (checks weight/rate/LTV before deduction), preventing any negative-value display. No hardcoded currency symbols — all monetary output goes through money(value, currency). deductionInput defaults to 0 via `deductionInput ?? 0` so empty deduction correctly means zero.

No 404 network resource on the gold-loan page was captured in console — one 'Failed to load resource: 404' was observed but likely a favicon/static asset unrelated to feature logic; recommend main agent verify.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Gold Loan Calculator is fully functional. All formula math verified: NetWeight = Gross - Deductions (grams or % of gross); 22K-eq = Net * (Purity/22); Value = 22K-eq * Rate; Loan = Value * (LTV/100). Currency persistence via localStorage confirmed (INR persists across reload). Validation errors correctly use role='alert'. Segmented control uses data-testid='segment-grams'/'segment-percent'. Only nit is homepage 'Popular Calculators' section doesn't include Gold Loan — main agent should decide if this is by design.
